incident_name: US East 1 - Unity Catalog (Partial Service Disruption)
incident_description:
Impact Summary
Between 30 January 2026 14:32 UTC and 30 January 2026 18:45 UTC, Catalog Explorer search and the global search UI in AWS US-East-1 may have failed to return expected results.

Symptoms
Affected customers may have observed search results in Catalog Explorer or the global search UI returning fewer objects than expected

Current Status
This incident is resolved. Normal Catalog Explorer search functionality has been restored.

Next Update
No further updates are planned unless conditions change. 
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. If you require further details about this incident, please submit a support ticket or contact help@databricks.com.

Impact Summary
Between 28 January 2026 15:05 UTC and 28 January 2026 19:45 UTC, Serverless and Classic Compute in AWS eu-west-1 experienced cluster creation failures and job execution interruptions.

Symptoms
Affected customers may have observed:
* Serverless and Classic cluster creation attempts may not complete
* Job runs may fail to start or show a failed status
* Notebook operations may experience delays or timeouts

Current Status
The incident is now closed. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. If you require further details about this incident, please submit a support ticket or contact help@databricks.com.

Between 20:13 UTC and 23:50 UTC on January 15, 2026, customers may have experienced degraded performance while using SQL Warehouses.

The incident is now closed. If you require further details about this incident, please submit a support ticket or contact help@databricks.com.

Between 06:30 UTC January 14 and 06:45 UTC January 15, 2026, customers may experience failures or delays when launching Serverless compute resources, including Notebooks, Delta Live Tables (DLT), or jobs.

The incident is now closed. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. If you require further details about this incident, please submit a support ticket or contact help@databricks.com.
